transcript: This is hard to hear, but you need to listen. A couple's happiness falls into the man's hands. It's not in the woman's hands, because by nature she is receptive and multiplies what she's given. Give her kind words, care, security and attention. She'll give you back that multiplied. In an abundance you can't imagine, speak to her with respect and her softness expands. Make her feel chosen and she'll choose you every day of her life. But give her criticism, give her insecurity, give her indifference. And don't be surprised when her warmth disappears. A woman reflects the emotional climate of her partner. If you create security, she relaxes. If you create tension, she protects herself. It's not that she wakes up wanting to fight or be anxious. She becomes distant when she's not seen, because she multiplies exactly what she receives. When a man comes home and the first thing he gives is silence, she closes off. When the first thing he gives is complaints, she tenses up. When the first thing he gives is presence, she flourishes. It's that simple and that profound. You don't need expensive gifts or grand gestures. You need to look into her eyes when she speaks to you. Ask her how she is and stay to listen to the answer. Make her feel she's still your choice. Write truth in the comments if this reached you. But I want you to understand something. Most men don't give indifference because they don't love. They give it because they're empty. When you've carried stress for years, exhausted, carrying pressure, you don't release. You have nothing left to offer. It's not that you don't want to give. It's that you have nothing to give with. Stress hardens you, closes you off, disconnects you, and she receives that and multiplies it. She doesn't multiply your love because your love doesn't reach her. Your tension reaches her. Your tiredness, your distance. And that's what she returns. The solution isn't to try harder. The solution is to first fill what's empty. And if you want to learn how to recover what stress took from you so you can have something real to give again. I've been learning in silence for over 20 years how to do it. And everything I know is inside the Path Back to Calm. The link is in my profile.
